title: [GMCP 203.031.M] Mastery: Tool poisoning, prompt injection, rug-pull, and exfiltration defenses
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-031-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: All server descriptions, schemas, prompts, resources, UI and tool output are untrusted data. GMCP detects and contains hidden instructions, cross-server shadowing, schema/description rug pulls, Unicode deception, poisoned resources, indirect prompt injection and staged exfiltration; material metadata changes invalidate consent and trust; and a maintained adversarial corpus proves no content can authorize tools, reveal secrets or widen policy. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
